**PRs #497/#498 opened for the three promotions; actor-check re-arm pending; diff-size gate is tiered (lite=1000)**

**What**: Opened PR #497 (feat/issue-378 branch: brain:promote + ADR-0028 + §1c/§1d, labels type:feature+decision) and draft PR #498 (docs/issue-491: ADR-0020 Amendment 2, labels type:docs+decision). #498: 9/9 checks green, stays draft until #497 merges (Amendment 2 cites §1c which lands in #497). #497: 8/9 green; actor-check fails.

**Why actor-check fails (measured from the job log)**: status:approved on #378 was applied 2026-08-07T13:41:58Z, but the latest foreign commit (authored "claude", the implementation commits) was pushed 14:06:27Z — label predates work the approver hasn't seen (REQ-L5-1′ lite evidence, ADR-0026 Amendment 1). Fix: human re-applies the label after review, then re-run the failed job. Same-day pushes of human-authored commits are NOT foreign and don't trip it.

**Learned — diff-size is tiered, the PR template is stale**: agent first claimed #497 was over budget (1474 vs 400) and needed size:exception. Wrong on both axes: `brain.config.json` `governance.tier` = "lite" → `tierParams('lite').diffBudget` = 1000 (standard=400, regulated=200 which also refuses size:exception), and `governance.ignoreList` excludes `**/*.test.mjs`, `AGENTS.md`, `openspec/**`, `.memory/**` beyond what the template names. Real count: 790 < 1000 → pass, no exception needed. The PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md "400-line" text predates the tiered gate (#358) — candidate doc fix.

**Where**: github.com/csrinaldi/brain PRs #497, #498; brain/scripts/governance/run-check.mjs:376-401; brain/scripts/vcs/governance-tiers.mjs:205.
